clayresearch.note: Integrated branch considered through current program and mesh contracts; no fresh branch final report enumerated because connector has no directory-listing/preflight execution surface.

cross_branch_implications.gwt: Directed-flow readouts should require declared conditioning sets/common-driver controls and must be paired with higher-order/interventional tests.
cross_branch_implications.claycode: BASE types should represent intervention distribution identity, conditioning-set identity, estimator family/version, null family, rescue identity/provenance and estimator disagreement rather than one emergence scalar.
cross_branch_implications.hyperposition: Higher-order relation evidence should include pairwise-reduction failure plus interventional synergy/rescue, not graph irreducibility alone.
cross_branch_implications.harness: Golden emergence traces should include matched common-driver false-positive and XOR pairwise-false-negative fixtures before live FRANK claims.
cross_branch_implications.frank: Observability plane should preserve measured driver/context variables so conditional information-flow estimates remain possible.
cross_branch_implications.claygraph: Graph edges/hyperedges should carry measurement ancestry and control identities; topology is not itself causal evidence.
cross_branch_implications.unifieddb: Persist conditioning sets, intervention distributions, estimator versions, replay hashes and null/control outcomes as first-class provenance.

promotion_note: This run creates OPEN research deltas and synthetic evidence only; it does not promote canonical scientific claims or target-runtime evidence.
